notes: minScore 90: gate for doctor excellence track.
Ignored rules — intentional product choices, not backlog:
security/require-guards-on-endpoints — JwtAuthGuard is APP_GUARD global; per-route @Public/@Roles cover exceptions.
architecture/require-module-boundaries — monorepo-style feature modules share RepositoriesModule; strict boundaries would force a large restructure.
performance/no-unused-module-exports — several exports exist for tests / future wiring and CLI reuse.
ignore.files — CLI / one-shot scripts outside Nest DI (manual new + process.env OK):
sync-masters, sync-ports, migrate-cli, seed, src/dev/* local ops scripts.
architecture/no-manual-instantiation excludeClasses — lightweight collaborators (MasterResolver) and runtime Mesh wire-up (MastersSyncService/MeshClient) are not Nest providers by design.
